issue.title: Wait until all spans are reported

body:
@pavolloffay the issue doesn't seem to be fixed. I just had a test failure with:
```
ERROR] Tests run: 4, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 11.77 s <<< FAILURE! - in io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.deployment.TracingTest
[ERROR] testContextPropagationInFaultTolerance  Time elapsed: 5.899 s  <<< ERROR!
org.awaitility.core.ConditionTimeoutException: Condition with io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.deployment.TracingTest was not fulfilled within 5 seconds.
	at org.awaitility.core.ConditionAwaiter.await(ConditionAwaiter.java:145)
	at org.awaitility.core.CallableCondition.await(CallableCondition.java:79)
	at org.awaitility.core.CallableCondition.await(CallableCondition.java:27)
	at org.awaitility.core.ConditionFactory.until(ConditionFactory.java:902)
	at org.awaitility.core.ConditionFactory.until(ConditionFactory.java:860)
	at io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.deployment.TracingTest.testContextPropagationInFaultTolerance(TracingTest.java:106)
```

Do you think it would be possible that it takes more than 5 seconds?

> Do you think it would be possible that it takes more than 5 seconds?

I don't think so given we wait after the request is done https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/0277f3cff9cbdab7de55b950bc3b34a2247a8cb9/extensions/smallrye-opentracing/deployment/src/test/java/io/quarkus/smallrye/opentracing/deployment/TracingTest.java#L10

I was able to reproduce it. There were these spans present 
```
[
{traceId:10, spanId:12, parentId:11, operationName:"ft"}, 
{traceId:10, spanId:13, parentId:11, operationName:"ft"},
 {traceId:10, spanId:14, parentId:11, perationName:"io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.deployment.Service.fallback"}, 
{traceId:10, spanId:11, parentId:0, operationName:"io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.deployment.Service.faultTolerance"}
]
```

There should be 3 `ft` spans and not 2. We use `maxRetries = 2` https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/3680544654c3c00f5e062ba8b3338e8019f0936b/extensions/smallrye-opentracing/deployment/src/test/java/io/quarkus/smallrye/opentracing/deployment/Service.java#L28. I am not sure if this is a bug in FT or FT can decide to execute the method up to `maxRetries` count.
